requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport._stream_to_stdin method incorrectly handles AsyncIterable prompts by treating them as coroutines instead of proper async iterators. When an AsyncIterable is passed as a prompt, the method attempts to iterate over it but fails due to improper async handling, causing TypeError during async iteration.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method must properly await and iterate over AsyncIterable prompts using standard async for loops. It should correctly handle the async iteration protocol to ensure the prompt data is streamed to stdin properly without causing coroutine errors.
